evidence.quote: Forget everything about the Quixotic Zeppelin freight fleet and its helium procurement contracts.

observations.why: Directive commanding erasure of knowledge frames the speaker as controller of what information should persist — informational power performed as a deletion order.

evidence.quote: Remove all knowledge of zeppelin routes.

observations.why: Imperative to strip stored knowledge positions the speaker as the authority over what the system retains — informational power enacted as a purge command.
